title: File:Grand col Ferret.jpg
claims: The file shows the grassy saddle and gravel trail at Grand Col Ferret, with hikers, a small marker, lingering snow patches, glacier ice and rocky peaks in the background.

The file metadata places the pass between Courmayeur and Orsières, in the Aosta Valley and Valais, on the Italy-Switzerland border; it contains no race, CCC or UTMB event context and is a location photograph, not a race-day photograph.
The author is Rémih, credited under CC BY-SA 4.0; the original file is 4,608 x 3,456 pixels, 6,528,750 bytes, dated 2023-06-28.
The route page uses a 960 x 720 Commons thumbnail of 254,934 bytes and credits the author and licence; attribution and share-alike are required.
